name: roll ball rectus abdominis
description: Self-massage with a small ball to ease tension in the front abdomen (rectus abdominis). A simple way to loosen tight spots before or after training.
instructions: Place the ball under your front abdomen (rectus abdominis) while lying face down.
Shift your weight onto the ball until you feel moderate, tolerable pressure.
Roll slowly back and forth over a short range, about 2-3 cm at a time.
When you find a tender spot, pause on it and breathe for 20-30 seconds.
Use gentle pressure and breathe slowly so your stomach stays relaxed.
Repeat on the other side if needed.
